user.title: Connect your Smart Garden
user.description: In Smart Garden open **My account → Connection keys**, make a key and paste it here.

data_description.url: The address you open Smart Garden at, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:5120
data_description.key: Starts with sg_. It acts as the account that made it.

reauth_confirm.title: New connection key needed
reauth_confirm.description: The key for {url} was revoked or its account is off. Make a new one in Smart Garden (My account → Connection keys).

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach Smart Garden at that address, or it needs updating to a version with connection keys.
error.invalid_auth: That connection key is wrong or revoked (after 5 wrong tries, wait 15 minutes).

abort.already_configured: This garden is already set up - its address and key were updated.
abort.wrong_garden: That address is a different garden.

data.sidebar: Show the Smart Garden dashboard in the sidebar
data.panel_url: Also show the full app at this address (optional)

data_description.panel_url: Adds a second sidebar item with the whole Smart Garden app. It only stays signed in when the address is on the same site as Home Assistant - for HTTPS, e.g. https://your-ha-address/garden/ through your reverse proxy. Leave empty for just the dashboard.

water.name: Water zone
water.description: Water a zone for some minutes, or until its soil sensor says it's right. Waits its turn if another zone is watering; the zone's safety limit always applies.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long. Leave empty for the zone's usual minutes.

until_soil.name: Until the soil is right
until_soil.description: Stop when the soil sensor reaches the zone's target (needs a working soil sensor).
